content.comment_body: I bought a PLC from Ebay, but I've realized I can't stop it using the keypad or perform a reset as I expected. I just want to completely clear the system and its program. Any advice? I tried running the reset procedure but it didn’t work, unless I missed something. Any assistance before I consider disposing of it?
Which model do you have? Please provide the full order number and firmware version.

Hi [user_name], happy holidays to you as well. I've managed to access the unit, but I'm having trouble with certain locked configuration states (LSC & LWE); I'm unable to disable them. I have erased the program and can change the IP address. There was an SD card issue, but it's now resolved using Fat32 format.. [article_no]

I think you meant [article_no]. Have you checked the device display to see if it’s in admin mode? The default password is "[product_name]", unless it was changed. Once in admin mode, the entire menu should be accessible.

I'm unable to remove or modify the LSW; it's always prompting for the password, which is just [product_name]. I tried switching to admin, cleared the program and passwords, but this configuration persists. I can only view it fully using the official software for [product_name] V8.3, and in that section the boxes are greyed out and ticked. Is it possible to upgrade or reinstall the firmware to resolve this? I’m able to upload the program successfully, but this persistent section remains. Any suggestions?
It should be possible, but I couldn't locate the English documentation for it. Best regards, [user_name] (translated with Google)
Hi [user_name], I found the same source, but I haven’t managed to complete a firmware update—though I followed the instructions. See attachment. Thanks for your help, it might not be resolvable.

It's tough to assess this remotely, especially since your pictures show the locked configuration rather than the device display itself. My intuition is that this issue is probably why it was sold. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user purchased a pre-owned PLC and faced issues resetting it and clearing persistent locked settings (such as LSC/LSW), even after erasing the program and resetting passwords. While some settings were accessible and an SD card formatting issue was resolved, certain system configurations remained locked and inaccessible, causing doubt about the device's reliability. Responses suggest firmware limitations or residual settings after a factory reset can hinder full control, which may affect confidence in used equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to fully erase prior configurations, reset the device to initial factory state, and gain complete control over all system settings without residual restrictions from the previous owner.
